next.reason: The 1985 rule only points to where the SAME RECORD/SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clause is presented. 2023's I-O-CONTROL format holds '{ same-clause }…' 'where apply-commit-clause and same-clause are shown below' (§2023:12.4.6.2), and §2023:12.4.6.4.2 gives 'Format 2 (record-area)' and 'Format 3 (sort-merge-area)'. The general and syntax rules (GR2, GR4, SR1) carry the clause's semantics, not this pointer.
